summary: feat(settings): update reset password start page copy for passkeys
description:
Because:

* The reset password page didn't point passkey or social-login users
  back to sign-in
* The data recovery warning sat above the form, ahead of the main action

This commit:

* Updates the heading and body copy; the body links to email-first
  sign-in and keeps the query params
* Moves the data recovery warning below Continue as small print with a
  SUMO "Learn more" link
* Removes the "Sign in" footer, its passkey props, and its Glean events
* Adds Glean auto-click ids to both new links
* Updates unit tests, mocks, and the functional page object; adds a
  functional test for the body link

Closes #FXA-13258
